author: w0nders
body:
Hi guys it's me Fauin. After a long time of customizing and taking textures from great packs, I present to you my edit mashup!
It consists of avicus type textures, along with some uhc additions such as the bow.

Images: http://imgur.com/a/CuTcK


Download Link: https://www.mediafire.com/?r9qh7alccei1hif


Have fun!
